def _get_numbers_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    """
    Get the distance of 2 numbers. The output is a number between 0 to the max.
    When max is returned means the 2 numbers are really far, and 0 means they are equal.
    """

        num1 = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num1) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num1)

        distance = abs(num1 - num2) / divisor
